title: House Robber
description: You are a robber planning to rob houses along a street. Each house has a certain amount of money stashed. Adjacent houses have security systems connected that trigger alarms if two adjacent houses are broken into. Return the maximum amount of money you can rob without alerting the police.
input_format: First line contains integer `n`, followed by `n` integers.
hints: At each house, decide whether to rob it or skip it.
Maintain only the previous two states in variables.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n = int(data[0])
    nums = [int(x) for x in data[1:1+n]]
    rob1, rob2 = 0, 0
    for n in nums:
        temp = max(n + rob1, rob2)
        rob1 = rob2
        rob2 = temp
    print(rob2)
